_comment: HIMMEL-5317 graphify leg A/B task set. Ground truth is NOT stored here: truth.py computes it from the pinned base sha with the rule named in each task's `truth` field, so the answer is fixed before any run and the rubric is an exact set match.
answer_format: Finish your reply with exactly one line: ANSWER: ["item1", "item2", ...] -- a JSON array of strings, each a bare basename or repo-relative path as the question asks, no other text on that line.

tasks.prompt: In this repository, scripts/hooks/run-hook-with-bash.js defines a constant named MUST_RUN_CHAIN_MEMBERS. List every hook script basename that is a member of that set (e.g. 'foo.sh'). Read-only: do not modify anything.

List every tracked test file under scripts/ (a file whose basename starts with 'test-') that references scripts/lib/graphify-bin.sh, i.e. contains the string 'graphify-bin.sh'. Give repo-relative paths. Read-only: do not modify anything.

List every tracked '.sh' file under scripts/ whose basename does NOT start with 'test-' and which is NOT under a directory named 'fixtures', and that mentions 'console-kit/go.sh' (the console GO writer) anywhere in its text, comments included, other than console-kit/go.sh itself. Give repo-relative paths. Read-only: do not modify anything.

List every tracked file under scripts/ that mentions 'ci-trust-paths.txt' and whose basename does NOT start with 'test-', does NOT contain '.test.', is NOT under a directory named 'fixtures', and is not scripts/ci/ci-trust-paths.txt itself. Give repo-relative paths. Read-only: do not modify anything.

scripts/lanes/plugin-profiles.json defines named plugin profiles under its top-level 'profiles' key. List the names of every profile whose 'mcpServers' list is exactly ["qmd"] (qmd and nothing else). Read-only: do not modify anything.
